targetText: The late member of the German diet, Dr. Lasker, delivered a lecture in Berlin, during the seventies, in which he arrived at the conclusion that it is possible for all members of society to have an equal standard of education.
summary: Describing the socialist education system, Bebel envisions universal, secular, co-educational schooling that combines physical development, scientific instruction, and practical polytechnical training from early childhood, freeing parents from financial burdens.
